findings.evidence: Mathlib has `Basis.equiv_symm` (LinearAlgebra/Basis/Defs.lean:587) and `Basis.repr_unitsSMul` (LinearAlgebra/Basis/SMul.lean:126: `(e.unitsSMul w).repr v i = (w i)⁻¹ • e.repr v i`).
findings.fix: Drop `hA` and prove `hcoord` directly: `rw [Basis.equiv_symm]`, then `simp [Basis.equiv, c, w, Basis.repr_unitsSMul]` (or similar).
findings.issue: `hA` is built by hand from `congrArg`, `equiv_apply`, `repr_self` and `.trans`, only to be pushed back through `congrArg` in `hcoord`. This detour hides the simple fact the proof needs: `o.toBasis.repr (A.symm x) = c.repr x`, combined with `Basis.repr_unitsSMul`.

findings.evidence: Lines 89–94 of the diff: `rw [hvol, TauCeti.volume_l1Ball, hdet, abs_mul, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, abs_inv, abs_of_pos (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => ha i)]` followed by `rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr …).le) (abs_nonneg _))]`.
findings.fix: After `rw [hvol, TauCeti.volume_l1Ball, hdet]`, use `rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]; congr 1`, then close with `rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]` and `field_simp`/`simp [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]; ring`. Use `positivity` instead of the explicit `mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr …)` terms.
findings.issue: The final step chains seven named rewrites (`abs_mul`, `Finset.prod_inv_distrib`, `abs_inv`, `abs_of_pos …`), then `← ENNReal.ofReal_mul` with a hand-built nonnegativity term. This breaks when Mathlib renames any of these lemmas or changes how the goal is normalised.

summary: The proofs avoid `change`/`show` and do not lean on undocumented definitional equality, but two steps are hard to follow and fragile: the `hA` → `hcoord` detour and the rewrite chain at the end. Both can be replaced by direct computation or more automated steps.
